title: Concept: Installs no longer save exact versions
description: .npmrc declares a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges.
